newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt overnight rates fall at end of week.
newsitem.headline: Egypt overnight rates fall at end of week.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound fell on Thursday in the private sector because of usual end-of-week liquidity, bankers said.
Many bankers said they did not make any deals but one bank dealt overnight at 10-1/4 percent and one received an offer of 11 percent. Rates on Wednesday ranged from 10-3/8 to 11-1/2.

Thursday, the last trading day of the week, is usually the most liquid day because banks have a clear idea how much they need to set aside to meet their reserve requirements, which are based on a five-day average.
Few bankers dealt one-week but one cited a rate of 10-3/8 percent, compared with about 10-1/2 on Wednesday.
